accounting.title: Powering the Future of DeFi Investment
accounting.intro: DeFiVestor is more than an investment platform — it’s your gateway to smarter, safer, and more profitable participation in decentralized finance. We combine deep analytics, automation, and human insight to help users navigate DeFi with confidence and clarity.

tailored.title: DeFi Portfolio Management
tailored.description: Take complete control of your digital wealth with one dashboard that unifies all your DeFi assets. Track tokens, liquidity pools, yield farms, and staking rewards across multiple chains — all in real time. DeFiVestor helps you see where your money is, how it’s performing, and how to optimize your portfolio for maximum growth.

scripts.title: Automated Yield Optimization
scripts.description: Let smart algorithms do the heavy lifting. Our AI-driven optimization engine analyzes top DeFi protocols to automatically suggest — or even execute — the most rewarding opportunities for your assets. From liquidity provision to staking, DeFiVestor ensures your capital never sits idle.

hands_on.title: Risk Intelligence & Analytics
hands_on.description: DeFi can be unpredictable — but your decisions don’t have to be. DeFiVestor’s analytics engine provides deep insights into asset volatility, protocol health, liquidity stability, and smart contract risks. With real-time alerts and risk scoring, you can invest boldly while staying protected.

privacy.title: Institutional & Retail Investment Support
privacy.description: Whether you’re an individual investor or a fund, DeFiVestor provides the tools to scale. Manage multiple wallets, customize strategies, and access institutional-grade reporting. We empower both solo traders and professional managers to thrive in DeFi with transparency and efficiency.

formalization.title: Our Approach
formalization.description: At DeFiVestor, we believe decentralized investment should be accessible to everyone — not just crypto experts. That’s why our platform combines simplicity with sophistication. Every service we offer is built around three principles: Transparency, where every transaction and yield source is verifiable on-chain; Automation, with AI and analytics working in the background to save you time and effort; and Empowerment, ensuring you stay in control with full visibility and ownership of your assets. We don’t just help you invest — we help you understand, optimize, and grow sustainably in the evolving DeFi economy.

contact.message: Includes a full DeFi health check, portfolio review, and custom investment blueprint with a short summary of your situation.

pricing.title: Consultation Services
pricing.intro: Want to get started but unsure where to begin? DeFiVestor offers one-on-one consultation sessions with our investment specialists to help you build a personalized DeFi roadmap. Whether you’re new to decentralized finance or managing an existing portfolio, we’ll guide you through asset allocation, risk management, and protocol selection.

initial_consultation.title: Initial Consultation
initial_consultation.description: The initial consultation takes from 1-3 hours on average. We'll dig into your portfolio: review your DeFiVestor data, check your wallets, exchanges, and DeFi activity, and map out what needs to be done. You'll get a clear plan and an honest assessment of the work involved.

custom_quote.title: Tailored to Your Goals
custom_quote.description: We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all investing. Every session is designed around your experience level, financial goals, and preferred risk tolerance — ensuring your DeFi journey is personal, informed, and strategic.

transparent_fair.title: Expert Guidance for Real Growth
transparent_fair.description: Our specialists analyze live data from your wallets and the market to provide actionable insights. You’ll leave each session with a clear, data-driven plan for building stronger returns while minimizing risk.

important_note.title: Important note
important_note.paragraph1: DeFiVestor’s consultation service is designed to help you make sense of your decentralized financial journey. We provide comprehensive crypto accounting, portfolio analysis, and data preparation to ensure your investment records are accurate, organized, and ready for strategic use. Our goal is to help you and your financial advisors gain a clear understanding of your complete on-chain and off-chain activity — from trading and yield farming to staking and liquidity positions.
important_note.paragraph2: Please note that we do not offer tax advice or file tax returns. Instead, we equip you with professionally structured data and reports that your accountant or tax expert can easily interpret. If needed, our team can collaborate directly with your financial advisor or tax professional, ensuring a smooth, transparent process that saves you time and eliminates confusion when managing your DeFi investments.

products.description: DeFiVestor is your all-in-one decentralized investment hub — built to simplify how you track, analyze, and grow your digital wealth. Whether you’re just starting out or managing a complex portfolio, DeFiVestor brings every asset, trade, and yield together with real-time analytics and AI-driven insights. No more spreadsheets or fragmented tools — just clarity, control, and confidence in every move you make. DeFiVestor helps you understand your performance, predict market shifts, and make smarter, data-backed decisions — all in one powerful, transparent platform.

asset_amount_and_value.description: DeFiVestor’s AI analyzes on-chain data, market sentiment, and protocol performance to generate actionable insights. From identifying high-yield pools to warning about rug-pull risks, our AI helps you act intelligently, not impulsively.

distribution_assets.description: Measure your exposure across assets, sectors, and chains. DeFiVestor helps you understand how much risk you carry in stablecoins, volatile tokens, or leveraged positions — giving you the clarity to rebalance your portfolio confidently.

events_analysis.description: Beyond DeFi wallets, DeFiVestor connects to leading centralized exchanges to aggregate all your assets in one place. Track trades, deposits, and withdrawals across CEXs like Binance and Coinbase alongside your DeFi activity — one clear balance sheet, total control.
events_analysis.title: Multi-Wallet & Exchange Syncing

detailed_graphs.description: Never miss your rewards again. DeFiVestor continuously monitors your staking, lending, and yield farming positions, showing pending and claimed rewards with estimated APY and ROI projections. Your income streams are automatically tracked and visualized — effortlessly.

enriched_transactions.description: Connect your wallet once, and DeFiVestor automatically pulls in balances, historical transactions, and liquidity positions. Whether you use MetaMask, WalletConnect, or hardware wallets, integration is seamless — with full privacy and zero custody over your keys.
enriched_transactions.title: Smart DeFi Wallet Syncing & Enrichment

events_analysis.description: DeFiVestor believes in verifiable trust. Every transaction, action, and data point is recorded and sourced directly from the blockchain — no intermediaries, no manipulation, no hidden APIs. You see the truth, backed by cryptographic evidence.

higher_limits.description: Stay on top of your wealth with a dynamic view of your total DeFi net worth. contact_section.subtitle: For media inquiries or additional information about rotki, please reach out to:
contact_section.title: Contact us

values.subtitle: Our mission is to empower users to take control of their finances both in and out of crypto in a transparent and auditable way while enabling them to own their data through a self-sovereign application.
values.title: Nice to meet you

values_section.description: We are driven by a set of core values that guide our every action and decision. Our commitment to these values is what sets us apart and ensures that our users receive the utmost quality and service.

line_1.title: We are:
line_1.value: a team of dedicated builders driven by our love for what we create. Our passion lies in developing applications that bring tangible value to our users. We believe in the power of open-source development, as it enables transparency, audibility, and the provision of user guarantees.

line_2.title: We build:
line_2.value:
- {open_source}: Because that's the only way to create transparent applications that can be audited and provide users with guarantees.
- {local_first}: Building local applications that store all data locally is the only way to guarantee data privacy and true ownership. Nobody can deny access to the app or the data to the user if it's a local application.

line_3.title: We welcome:
line_3.value:
external open-source contributors who understand our mission and utilise our product themselves, driven by the desire to help it reach its maximum potential.

Our team can independently shoulder their responsibilities, taking ownership of their work. We value teamwork and collaboration, emphasising the importance of collective effort rather than individual stardom.

values_section.title: Values

vision_section.description: rotki is the portfolio tracking, management and accounting tool for your finances. The one-stop app for viewing and managing your finances. rotki aspires to:

list.line_1: Be the one place to track your entire portfolio across on-chain crypto, banks, stocks, trades and more.
list.line_2: Allow you to manage your finances, perform trades across CEXes, on-chain swaps, and other brokers from one interface.
list.line_3: Create monthly/quarterly/yearly reports covering assets across all mentioned locations.
list.line_4: A modular system that many contributors outside our team can extend. For example, if someone wants to integrate tax accounting rules for a specific jurisdiction, they are experts on or integrate a chain they know of.

vision_section.title: Vision
